analysis.one_line_summary: Static Black Friday receipt graphic advertising the WavyTalk Salon Pro Duo bundle for $157.00 with a 31% discount.
analysis.full_description: A static promotional graphic designed to look like a crumpled store receipt against a dark textured burgundy background. At the top of the receipt, the WavyTalk logo appears above 'Black Friday', followed by large bold text '$157.00 | 31% OFF' and a pill badge reading 'You save: $71.99'. Below a dashed dividing line, an itemized table lists 'SALON PRO DUO' (QTY 1) consisting of 'Turblow Pro + Steambrush Pro 2.0'. Below this, studio product renders of both devices in light pastel pink are displayed side-by-side: the Turblow Pro compact hair dryer and the Steambrush Pro 2.0 steam straightening brush emitting visible vapor. A deep purple circular sticker on the right reads 'TODAY ONLY', and barcode receipt cutouts frame the corners.

on_screen_text.text:

Turblow Pro + Steambrush Pro 2.0
